description: Newest items created or edited on Wikidata right now, from the live MediaWiki recent-changes feed. Answers "which Wikidata item was created most recently", "what QIDs were created today", "what changed on Wikidata in the last hour", "recent edits to Wikidata items". Returns each change newest-first with its Q-id, revision id, previous revision id, UTC timestamp, editing user, edit comment and byte size, plus a cursor for paging further back.

cursor.description: Continue token from a previous call's "cursor" field, to page further back in time.

since.description: Stop at this UTC timestamp, ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-08-22T00:00:00Z"). Listing runs newest-first back to this point.

type.description: Which changes to list: "new" for freshly created items (default), "edit" for edits to existing items, "all" for both.

user.description: Only changes made by this Wikidata username (e.g. "Dsp13").

name: wikidata_recent_changes

lastrevid.description: Revision id created by this change

previous_revid.description: Revision replaced, or null for a newly created item

size_bytes.description: Size of the page after the change

size_change_bytes.description: Byte delta introduced by the change

user.description: Wikidata username that made the change

cursor.description: Continue token to page further back in time, or null at the end

hint.description: How to get a result when found is false

most_recent.description: Q-id of the most recent change, the first row

most_recent_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of that most recent change

namespace.description: Wikidata namespace listed (0 items, 120 properties, 146 lexemes)

reason.description: Machine-readable code when found is false (invalid_type, invalid_since, no_changes_in_window, or a Wikidata API error code)

type.description: Which changes were listed: new, edit or all

title: Wikidata Recent Changes
